request D has a 10-token prompt · chunked_prefill_size 4 in this example
REQ_TO_TOKEN: KV SLOT OF EACH POSITION · THE ROW STAYS WITH D BETWEEN CHUNKS
checkpoint_kv_cache() inserts the finished part into the tree and locks the new end node.
The lock keeps t0–t3 from eviction while D still needs them.
